name: Daitou Natsu
source:
4th year Japanese Cuisine student.
The straightforward one at the boarding house.
A dignified and quiet Japanese style guy.
He's the only son of a family that owns a traditional inn with quite the pedigree.
He's the only one at the boarding house that takes the rules seriously so he's known as the 'discipline committee leader'.
